name: Canyon Moon Palace — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Apricot sandstone palace attached to a vertical canyon shelf, turquoise onion domes, tall star banners, huge circular gilded moon screen/entry and water spilling between lower arches/rock piers. Iso climbs along the cliff; mini-plan is elongated with rounded room/tower ends. Hidden layout inference: A lower ledge arrival climbs a switchback garden stair to the moon-screen court, then to one sheltered upper dome terrace. Separate dry cliff-edge overlooks from lush irrigated court pockets; channels feed controlled falls and stay away from walking edges. Back depth/return route are inferred. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B10-DETAIL-001 — Canyon Moon Palace — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need cliff-embedded wall/round-tower hosts, moon-screen support/reveal, terrace/stair cutback and ghat/water-outlet junctions. Existing turquoise scale tiles, banners and moon lattice should be extracted. Dry shrubs/lizards plus palms/flowers near water; shared cliff/water families. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
